notes.title: Narita Boy - Re-bindable Keys [LIVE on all builds]
notes.content:
Hi heroes! 

We have published a new build [public_test_branch] with [u][b]key rebindings[/b][/u] in place! 

[h3]What you need to know:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Please be aware that - although we have tested this - you may experience some unknown bugs whilst playing. 

[*] We welcome your feedback on this build, so please don't hesitate to share your experiences with us, here, on the forums -- and on social media, too. 

[*] We're aiming to have this branch live as the main build by the end of April.

[*] Please read the following guide to help you access the new build [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2463021439][HERE]
[/url][/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/88JzulK.gif[/img]

Any questions, please let us know!

Thank you - and may the force of the Trichroma be strong within you.

notes.title: Narita Boy – Hotfix (Servohorse)
notes.content:
Hi all!

We've just updated Narita Boy with a new build, which is now live on Steam (PC). The following has been addressed:

[h3]Steam PC [/h3]

[list]
[*] Servohorse mini-game frame rate has been fixed, this section of the game is no longer too fast to deem unplayable

[*] Some text windows in French have unintentional “/” characters – these have been fixed.
[/list]

We will have mac news very soon!

Thank you for your patience whilst these issues have been fixed, we hope your experience in the Digital Kingdom is even better! Enjoy, Sons of the Trichroma.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ml9khR6.png[/img]

notes.title: Narita Boy Demo Extension & Keyboard Bug Fix!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey, everyone![/h3]

How about a little longer in the Digital Kingdom? 🌃 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rLoGfz5.gif[/img]

[h3]Keyboard Bug Fix [/h3]

We have addressed the keyboard space bar bug that many of you were experiencing — the Digital Kingdom should now be even more refined than before! 🔨

[h3]Demo Extension[/h3] 

And with that news, we've decided to EXTEND the Narita Boy demo for one more week!! We wanted our keyboard warriors to be able to have the same smooth vibes from our demo that our controller cousins enjoyed over the past week. You have until February 17th ;)

Thank you to all of you for your comprehensive, diligent and positive pieces of feedback over the past week; it's invaluable and heartwarming information — and we really appreciate you taking your time to connect with our passion project.

Enjoy yourselves, Sons of the Trichroma.

Stay tuned [url=https://twitter.com/studiokobaGAME]@studiokobaGAME[/url] for everything Narita Boy!
